description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is loaded in InVesalius 3. Your goal is to create a volumetric visualization of the skull using the Raycasting (volume rendering) technique. 

1. Enable the Raycasting/Volume Rendering mode in the 3D view.
2. Select a preset appropriate for visualizing bone (e.g., 'Bone', 'MIP', 'High Contrast', or similar).
3. Adjust the view to show the cranium clearly.
4. Export a picture/screenshot of the current view to '/home/ga/Documents/volume_render_bone.png'.

Note: Do NOT export a surface mesh (STL/OBJ). The goal is to export a 2D image of the volume rendering visualization.
